item.title: Hepta Refractory Multiple Myeloma Shows Genomic Complexity
item.description: Hepta refractory multiple myeloma is characterised by antigen loss, complex genomic alterations, and poor survival, with limited benefit from successive salvage therapies. The post Hepta Refractory Multiple Myeloma Shows Genomic Complexity appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cesarean Delivery Linked to Postmolar Neoplasia Risk
item.description: Prior cesarean delivery was linked to higher postmolar gestational trophoblastic neoplasia risk, without increased chemoresistance overall. The post Cesarean Delivery Linked to Postmolar Neoplasia Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Apple Watch Improves Detection of Atrial Fibrillation, Study Shows
item.description: Smartwatch monitoring significantly improves atrial fibrillation detection, enabling earlier diagnosis and strengthening prevention strategies in high risk patients. The post Apple Watch Improves Detection of Atrial Fibrillation, Study Shows appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Salvage Focal Therapy Matches Surgery in Radiorecurrent PCa
item.description: Salvage focal therapy delivers similar 10-year survival to surgery in radiorecurrent prostate cancer, with significantly fewer perioperative complications. The post Salvage Focal Therapy Matches Surgery in Radiorecurrent PCa appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Elenagen Combination Extends Survival in Ovarian Cancer
item.description: Phase two data show Elenagen combined with gemcitabine significantly prolongs overall survival in platinum resistant ovarian cancer without added safety concerns. The post Elenagen Combination Extends Survival in Ovarian Cancer appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Few GLP 1 Studies Report Dietary Outcomes
item.description: A review of 41 trials finds only two assessed dietary intake with GLP 1 receptor agonists, underscoring a critical gap in nutrition research. The post Few GLP 1 Studies Report Dietary Outcomes appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Why Point of Care Ultrasound Is More than the Modern Rheumatologist’s Stethoscope

item.title: GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Linked to Lower Dementia Risk in CKD
item.description: GLP-1 receptor agonists were associated with lower dementia and Alzheimer’s risk in patients with type 2 diabetes and CKD stage 3 or later. The post GLP-1 Receptor Agonists Linked to Lower Dementia Risk in CKD appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Transcatheter Falls Short of Surgical Aortic Valve Replacement
item.description: Transcatheter aortic valve implantation results in a higher risk of mortality and stroke compared with surgical replacement, a 2026 systematic review has found. The post Transcatheter Falls Short of Surgical Aortic Valve Replacement appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: FDA ends ‘two-trial dogma’ in historic shift
item.description: The FDA has announced that a single clinical trial will now be the default requirement for the approval of novel medicines. The post FDA ends ‘two-trial dogma’ in historic shift appeared first on European Medical Journal.
